item.description:
Hold My Notes 1.0.5

  • Pasting into a note works again — ⌘V had been silently doing nothing
  • Your licence now lives in Settings, with its own section: subscription status, a key field to activate a subscription you already have, and a way to release the seat when you stop using a Mac
  • A green tick on the licence card tells you at a glance that this Mac is activated
  • The menu bar's subscription item opens Settings instead of a separate window
